title: Timeline of Amazon's Logistics Growth As It Looks to Test UPS, FedEx - Business Insider

Timeline of Amazon's Logistics Growth As It Looks to Test UPS, FedEx - Business Insider

# From zero planes, vans, or trucks in the beginning of the 2010s to delivering 3.5 billion packages this year, Amazon is becoming a logistics giant. Here's the timeline of its transformation.

 By Rachel Premack 

 

Toggle image caption 

 Amazon is grabbing onto logistics as yet another industry for it to disrupt. Hollis Johnson/Business Insider 

 2019-12-24T16:18:35.000Z 

Amazon has fueled the world's demand for free, fast shipping. But free shipping has ended up being pretty expensive for Amazon itself. 

Amazon's worldwide shipping costs grew fifteenfold from 2009 to 2018. Meanwhile, net sales have increased sevenfold.

That's motivated the tech-retail-media-advertising-and-so-on giant to add another industry it's vying to disrupt: logistics.
